_doc: Starter manifest for persona-test consistency mode. Replace this comment block when adopting. Real surface entries below — adapt to your app's state-rendering elements + engine endpoints.

collections._doc: Optional — declare collections (lists, grids, tables) before referencing them in surface engineFields with `scope`. Delete this block if your app has no collections.

surfaces._doc: Status chip / banner — single element projecting one engine field. The MINIMUM viable surface for first adoption. Recommended starting point: annotate ONE state-rendering surface, get the canary green, then expand.

locator._doc: Prefer kind:'id' (stable HTML id). Fall back to kind:'testid' for data-testid. kind:'css' triggers a P2 warning at canary run time — only use for nested attribute selectors.

surfaces._severityFloorGuidance: P0 = trust-critical (counts, financial state). P1 = important state for which graceful stale UX is OK (SWR-style chips). P2 = advisory copy where divergence is recoverable. P3 = informational. See docs/consistency-contract.md §Severity-floor-guidance.

surfaces._doc: Route-gated example — surface only applies on /?view=analysis (other views skip this check via appliesTo.routePattern). Delete this entry if your app has no view-routing.

networkSource._doc: Bump awaitTimeoutMs for slow recompute endpoints. Default is 3000ms.

surfaces._doc: State-gated example — surface only applies when stateV2='blocked'. The runner derives activeStateTags from chip-style domClaims (stateV2/state/mode/status engineFields on visible elements), so this gate is honoured iff one of your annotated surfaces projects the state value the rig needs.
Collection example — N rendered rows, each matched to a network response entry by `data-engine-key`. Delete if no collections.
